blockingIssues.problem: The title asserts that the bursary "has awarded 25 grants," presenting the awards as already made. The source states the board published a draft proposing 25 awards and explicitly says no awards have been made; applications are not open and awards are conditional on approval.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "The draft proposes 25 awards; no awards have been made." Also: "The board has published a draft; applications are not open. If approved in March, applications would open in May."
blockingIssues.constraint: Do not present proposed or conditional actions as implemented. Titles must reflect that the 25 awards are proposed/conditional and that applications are not yet open.
